description: This file defines a Java interface 'LoanProductRepository' that extends Spring Data JPA repository interfaces to provide data access methods for 'LoanProduct' entities. It includes custom query methods for retrieving loan products by charge ID, counting by delinquency bucket, finding non-null delinquency buckets, finding by external ID, and checking existence by ID.

classes.name: LoanProductRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data repository interface providing data access methods for 'LoanProduct' entities, including custom queries for retrieving loan products by charge ID, counting by delinquency bucket, finding by external ID, and checking existence by ID.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductsByChargeId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of 'LoanProduct' entities associated with a specific charge ID using a JPQL query.

methods.name: countByDelinquencyBucket
methods.description: Returns the count of 'LoanProduct' entities associated with a specific 'DelinquencyBucket'.

methods.name: findByDelinquencyBucketNotNull
methods.description: Finds all 'LoanProduct' entities where the 'delinquencyBucket' field is not null.

methods.name: findByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves a 'LoanProduct' entity based on its external ID.

methods.name: existsById
methods.description: Checks if a 'LoanProduct' exists with the specified ID.

calls: select loanProduct from LoanProduct loanProduct, IN(loanProduct.charges) charge where charge.id = :chargeId
